parameters.content:
▶ SECTION 1 — TRIGGER & CONFIG

Two entrypoints merge: Schedule (Mon+Wed 07:00 Manila) and Form (manual run). Config rows from Google Sheets Config tab. One niche/location processed at a time.

▶ SECTION 2 — SEARCH (APIFY GOOGLE MAPS)

Fetches MAX_LEADS_FETCHED results per niche/location via Apify compass~crawler-google-places actor. Polls until SUCCEEDED or timeout.

▶ SECTION 3 — DEDUPLICATION

Strips any URL already in the Leads tab. All-time, all runs. Guarantees every lead is new.

▶ SECTION 4 — INDUSTRY OVERVIEW (LLM)

One LLM call per niche before per-lead processing. Universal router: change LLM_PROVIDER in .env to switch between DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq.

assignments.name: system
assignments.value: You are a market research analyst. Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown. No explanation.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value: ={{ 'Industry overview for digital agency targeting local businesses. Niche: ' + $json.niche + '. Location: ' + $json.location + '. Return JSON: {"digital_maturity":"low|medium|high","common_pain_points":["p1","p2","p3"],"outreach_angle":"string","best_ready_products":["p1","p2"]}' }}

parameters.content:
▶ SECTION 5 — PER-LEAD ENRICHMENT

PageSpeed (Google, free) + Open PageRank (free). Circuit breaker stops on MAX_ERRORS_BEFORE_ABORT errors.

▶ SECTION 6 — LLM SCORING

One LLM call per lead across 5 dimensions: tech, SEO, brand, sales_readiness, expansion_score. Local business detection included.

assignments.name: system
assignments.value: You are a B2B lead scoring agent for a digital agency selling web services and software products to SMEs. Return ONLY valid JSON.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value: ={{ 'Score prospect (0-25 each, total max 100). Company: ' + $json.company + ', URL: ' + $json.url + ', Mobile perf: ' + $json.perfScore + '/100, HTTPS: ' + $json.hasHTTPS + ', SEO audit: ' + $json.seoAuditScore + '/100, PageRank: ' + ($json.pageRank??'N/A') + ', Industry: ' + JSON.stringify($workflow.vars.industryOverview??{}) + '. Return: {"tech_score":0,"seo_score":0,"brand_score":0,"sales_readiness":0,"expansion_score":0,"total":0,"is_local_business":"Yes|No|Unknown","top_3_flaws":["f1","f2","f3"],"opportunity_summary":"string","recommended_first_service":"string","expansion_opportunities":["p1","p2"],"expansion_reasoning":"string"}' }}

parameters.content:
▶ SECTION 7 — RANK & SELECT TOP 10

Accumulates all scored leads, then ranks by total score. Local businesses win tiebreaks. Resets accumulator for next batch.

▶ SECTION 8 — SHEETS WRITE & SCORE GATE

Top 10 written to Leads sheet. Leads >= SCORE_THRESHOLD proceed to MVP generation. Others marked Low Priority.

▶ SECTION 9 — MVP HTML GENERATION

For leads >= SCORE_THRESHOLD. LLM generates a source-protected HTML preview page. Deployed to Vercel free hosting. URL saved to Sheets.

assignments.name: system
assignments.value: Generate a single self-contained HTML file. Return ONLY raw HTML starting with <!DOCTYPE html>. No markdown. No code fences. No explanation.

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value: ={{ 'Create a professional HTML preview page for ' + $json.company + ' (website: ' + $json.url + '). Their worst flaw: ' + ($json.top_3_flaws?.[0]??'outdated design') + '. Service to showcase: ' + $json.recommended_first_service + '. Expansion opportunity: ' + ($json.expansion_opportunities?.[0]??'digital upgrade') + '. Requirements: 1) Solve the flaw visually. 2) Top banner: "This preview was prepared exclusively for ' + $json.company + '". 3) Footer: "MVP preview by [Your Agency] · [your email]". 4) Include right-click disabled JS + keyboard shortcut blocking + devtools detection. 5) Mobile-first, clean modern design. No lorem ipsum — use real niche-relevant content.' }}

parameters.content:
▶ SECTION 10 — EMAIL DIGEST

Runs after all leads processed. Summarises stats, expansion signals, errors with fix instructions. Sent via Gmail.

parameters.jsCode:
const runId=$workflow.vars.runId??'unknown'; const processed=$workflow.vars.processedCount??0; const localCount=$workflow.vars.localCount??0; const errorCount=$workflow.vars.errorCount??0; const skipped=$workflow.vars.skippedDups??0; const html=`

🤖 Lead Gen Digest

${new Date().toDateString()} · Run: ${runId}

${processed}
Leads processed
${localCount}
Local businesses
${skipped}
Skipped (dupes)
${errorCount}
Errors

📦 Expansion note: Local businesses with high Expansion Score are pre-qualified for your software product suite. Lead with the product angle before pitching the website redesign.

Open Leads Sheet →

Swap LLM: change LLM_PROVIDER + LLM_BASE_URL + LLM_MODEL + LLM_API_KEY in .env and restart Docker.
Add niche: new row in Config tab, Status = Active.

`; return [{json:{html,subject:`[Lead Digest] ${new Date().toDateString()} · ${processed} leads · ${localCount} local · ${errorCount} errors`}}];

parameters.content:
▶ SECTION 11 — ERROR LOGGER

Wire EVERY node's error output here. Increments errorCount (triggers circuit breaker). Writes each error to Errors sheet.
